summary: Itau Unibanco Holding S.A. furnished a Form 6-K on September 14, 2026, attaching Exhibit 99.1, its Related Party Transactions Policy (Brazil). The policy codifies definitions per CPC 05 and CVM rules, covering related-party identification, close family members, market-condition and significant-amount thresholds, and governance procedures across the Brazilian conglomerate. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are disclosed; this is a routine corporate-governance policy disclosure by a foreign private issuer. No deal terms, timeline, or regulatory clock apply. What to watch: no arbitrage angle; monitor future 6-K filings for actual transactions.
